meta_description: Pocari Sweat Run Indonesia 2026 Bandung review: September 19 -- a brand-backed half marathon and 10K in Indonesia's cool, elevated West Java capital.
dek: Set for 19 September 2026 in Bandung, this leg of the nationwide Pocari Sweat Run Indonesia series brings a sports-drink brand's hydration-focused race to West Java's cool highland capital, though the exact start venue hasn't been announced yet.
verdict: The Pocari Sweat Run's Bandung leg carries the backing of a major sports-drink brand, which typically means well-resourced hydration stations and event production -- a genuinely relevant selling point given the sponsor's business is literally electrolyte replacement. Two distances (21.1K and 10K) keep it focused rather than sprawling. Bandung itself is a real asset: sitting nearly 730 metres above sea level on a plateau, it has a notably milder climate than lowland Indonesian cities, and as the country's third largest city and West Java's capital, it offers strong infrastructure. The exact start venue within the city hasn't been announced yet, which is worth confirming before booking travel.

sections.heading: Bandung: A Cooler Highland Capital
paragraphs: Bandung is the capital of West Java province and Indonesia's third-largest city after Jakarta and Surabaya, sitting on a plateau nearly 730 metres above sea level roughly 180km southeast of Jakarta. [2] That elevation gives it a notably mild, pleasant climate compared to lowland Indonesian cities -- a genuine advantage for distance running compared to the humid coastal venues that dominate much of this research batch.

sections.heading: A Cultural and Educational Hub
paragraphs: Beyond its climate, Bandung is the centre of Sundanese cultural life, home to institutions like the Bandung Institute of Technology, and was the site of the historic 1955 Bandung Conference that symbolized the Non-Aligned Movement. [2] That gives race weekend genuine destination appeal beyond the run itself, for travellers who want to combine the race with sightseeing.
